en-US.description:
Wake up to a fresh AI-generated image of a native flower blooming near you today. Every morning, a new picture — matched to your region and the current season. Upgrade to the Premium Pass to unlock unlimited offline semantic searches, the full 7-day history archive, and regional Travel Mode.

### Features
- Offline-first SQLite database resolves regional plants instantly without internet.
- Curated botanical species database featuring native seasonal flora observations.
- Explore botanical common and Latin scientific names.

### Privacy
- Strict zero-data-collection policy caches location code locally.

### Legal
- Terms of Use (EULA): https://thescottyb.github.io/playing-in-the-sandbox-staring-at-flowers/terms.html
- Privacy Policy: https://thescottyb.github.io/playing-in-the-sandbox-staring-at-flowers/privacy.html
en-US.promoText: Wake up to your regional bloom ritual. Try offline semantic search, go back 7 days, or travel to other states. Lock in our limited Founders Edition Lifetime VIP pass!
en-US.releaseNotes: Introducing the Specimen Premium Pass! You can now unlock unlimited semantic searches using our offline Vector Vibe Search. We've also added the 7-day archive and regional Travel Mode so you can explore native flowers across all supported regions.
en-US.title: Specimen Sandbox
en-US.subtitle: Daily Native Flower Ritual

review.notes: Changes since the last review: (1) Guideline 2.1(b) — the unresponsive unlock button was caused by the production build missing its RevenueCat configuration, so no subscription products loaded and the button had nothing to purchase. The configuration is now included in the build, and the paywall additionally handles the no-products case with a clear error message and Retry instead of a silent failure. (2) Guideline 2.1(b) — the In-App Purchase products (premium_monthly, premium_yearly auto-renewable subscriptions and the premium_founders non-consumable) are now completed and submitted with this review. (3) Guideline 3.1.2(c) — the App Description now contains a functional Terms of Use (EULA) link (https://thescottyb.github.io/playing-in-the-sandbox-staring-at-flowers/terms.html). In the app, the paywall shows each pass's title, duration, and price, plus functional Privacy Policy and Terms of Use (EULA) links and the auto-renewal disclosure. --- Location note: the app requests location permission once on first launch to resolve the user's US state, Canadian province, or country via reverse-geocoding. The region code is cached locally and never transmitted off-device. Daily flower images are pre-generated server-side via a GitHub Actions cron and served from GitHub Pages — no user data is sent with these requests.
